title: Data Processing Module
summary: This module orchestrates data processing. It loads configuration, initializes a pipeline, generates a sample data batch, and executes the pipeline to process the batch, returning the operation's status.

nodes.label: Execute Data Processing
nodes.title: Main Processing Entry Point
nodes.description: The primary function that orchestrates the data processing workflow, from configuration loading to batch execution and result reporting.

nodes.label: Load Configuration
nodes.title: Configuration Loader
nodes.description: Retrieves essential configuration settings from the environment, crucial for initializing and operating the data processing pipeline effectively.

nodes.label: Initialize Pipeline
nodes.title: Pipeline Setup
nodes.description: Sets up the data processing pipeline, configuring it with the loaded settings to prepare for subsequent data transformation and analysis tasks.

nodes.label: Create Data Batch
nodes.title: Batch Generation
nodes.description: Constructs a new batch of data records, populating it with sample items ready to be fed into the processing pipeline for execution.

nodes.label: Run Pipeline on Batch
nodes.title: Batch Processing Execution
nodes.description: Executes the configured data processing pipeline on the prepared batch of records, performing all defined transformations and operations.

nodes.label: Return Processing Status
nodes.title: Processing Outcome Reporting
nodes.description: Reports the final status of the batch processing operation, indicating whether it completed successfully or encountered any issues.

groups.label: Entry Point
groups.title: Module Entry Point
groups.description: The main function that serves as the entry point for initiating the data processing operations within this module.

groups.label: Configuration
groups.title: Configuration Management
groups.description: Handles the loading of configuration settings required for the module's operation.

groups.label: Data Generation
groups.title: Batch Data Generation
groups.description: Responsible for creating and populating data batches that will be processed by the pipeline.

groups.label: Processing Logic
groups.title: Core Processing Logic
groups.description: Components that define and execute the actual data transformation and analysis steps within the processing pipeline.
